summary.name: Alors on Danse AI
summary.one_liner: A paid web tool that turns two uploaded adult face photos into a roughly 15-second white-studio mini-keyboard duo video with original AI audio.
use_cases: Make a viral-style studio dance clip from two friends' photos
Create a short dance video for TikTok or Reels
Remake the white-studio keyboard meme with yourself
Produce a 9:16 video for YouTube Shorts
Make a playful duo video without installing an app
summary.what_it_does: The site takes two uploaded face photos, one assigned to the keyboard player on the left and one to the dance partner on the right, and generates a roughly 15-second white-studio duo video. Paid exports include original AI electronic audio rather than the commercial song. Output is offered in 16:9 or 9:16 at 480p or 720p, with credit packs priced per video. Rendered MP4 download links are described as short-lived. The page states it is an independent fan tool with no app or subscription required.
notable: Two-photo input: left photo on keys, right photo as dance partner
Original AI audio instead of the commercial song
One-time credit packs ($8.88 single, $16.99 3-pack, $39.90 10-pack) with no account needed, paying via Stripe
Demo gallery labels which examples are closest to the paid export
caveats: Paid videos are about 15 seconds; longer demos are style references only
Requires clear adult face photos (18+ only, authorized photos); no NSFW use
Independent fan tool, not affiliated with Stromae, Jamel Debbouze, or any label; competitors exist
Render download links expire, so MP4s must be saved promptly
